realtime.scope: Production runtime receiver: full NPZ clips via original arrival buffer, legacy ankle ABI and actual SDK physics; no hardware. Same model, whole-foot XML, initial conditions, zero reference-height offset and 1ms x20 physics within every pair.
realtime.reference_sampling_note: Original real-time arrival-clock receiver with isolated publisher; full clips
realtime.target_law: raw=q0+0.5*raw_action; optional real SDK-order physical target clipping, ankle PR overrides [-.52,-.35]/[.61,.35]. Raw action history retained.
realtime.torque_delta_scope: Kp*(clipped-raw) describes instantaneous unsaturated physical-joint PD request (PR coordinates at ankles) delta with identical q/qd, not SDK AB motor torque after Jacobian and torque saturation.

full_walk_foot_contacts.scope: Physical contact samples at 50Hz pre-policy ticks, threshold normal force >1N; these are not 1kHz contact counts or true substep peak forces.

ankle_band_metrics.scope: Physical truth sampled at 50 Hz at policy calls; 10-25 Hz only, not full 1 kHz motor spectrum.
ankle_band_metrics.method: 4 s segments (or all if shorter), 50% overlap, per-channel linear detrend, Hann window, one-sided PSD with window-energy normalization, integrated 10-25 Hz power; merged RMS over all four PR joints.

experiment_manifest.scope: 18 actual MuJoCo closed-loop simulations; no hardware. Eight complete realtime receiver runs, eight frozen-window diagnostic runs (dance/walk60s), plus two frozen complete-walk runs. Final main frozen summary selects complete Pico/smallstep/walk and dance60s; original walk60 results retained separately.
